title: Kate Winslet seeks permission to replace rotting gates at £5 million Grade II-listed seaside home
summary_full: Kate Winslet has applied for permission to replace two sets of rotting wooden gates at her £5 million Grade II-listed seaside home in West Wittering, Sussex. The actress, who bought the property for £3.25 million in 2013, has proposed using treated timber to withstand harsh coastal conditions as concerns over flooding and erosion continue.
